reproduction_gate.statistic: per-cell equality of the UNRESTRICTED greedy nearest neighbour implied by the re-derived space

capacity_mechanism: node duplication: RNA cell j is replicated into c_j columns carrying identical costs, and the arm is a minimum-cost FULL ROW matching of the m x C matrix computed by the same scipy min_weight_full_bipartite_matching prep_04b uses. The estimator is the same routine on a larger graph.
capacity_scheme: c_j = 2 for the first round(frac*m) cells of a fixed per-block permutation seeded by (seed, block label), 1 for the rest; nested in frac, independent of the CCA space
method: prep_04b_link_restricted.py's within-block CCA linkage with a per-RNA-cell capacity imposed by node duplication; see module docstring
